title: ECoG finger flexion prediction (BCI Competition IV, Dataset 4)
input_description: Continuous 1000 Hz ECoG from three subjects (62, 48, and 64 channels).
output_description: Five continuous finger-flexion trajectories at 1000 Hz per subject.
native_split_description: The source provides 400000 labeled samples and 200000 evaluation-input samples per subject. BrainPilotBench reserves a chronological validation span inside the labeled 400000 samples and applies a boundary guard.
